svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Cost vs intelligence: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 against API cost per task, one line per model
svg.text: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 against API cost per task. One line per model joins its effort levels; larger dots
Data from Artificial Analysis, observed 2026-09-22 to 2026-10-07. Each point is the latest observation of that model and effort; snapshots share the
chart only where the settings they both list agree within 1 point. Cost is the API cost to run one index task.
The source re-measures cost between snapshots: the same setting's cost moved by up to 39%, and each point uses the latest.
Not plotted, no cost per task: Claude Opus 5.
1 more setting of plotted models has a score but no cost and is not drawn.
